selected_observations.excerpt: Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM. Invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited. That is the same legal entity. Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company; it sold sensors to us in 2018 and has no current MSA.

selection_rationale: Invoice-contract association for INV-1001 requires billed name, candidate governing contract counterparty line, and any authoritative linkage or identity notes.
known_missing_information: No mechanical invoice-to-contract join in P2; association depends on unresolved identity and optional source_asserted_invoice_contract.
